title: Noise stability of balanced Boolean functions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0<\rho<1$, and let $f$ be a function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to $\{\pm1\}$. If the mean of the real-valued function $f$ is zero, then the noise stability of $f$ at correlation $\rho$ is at most $\rho$.
